limitations: BBox, silhouette IoU, SSIM and cosine are reference measurements, not motion/quality acceptance.
Topmost-point direction can describe head/ear instead of kicking leg; axis and missing coverage remain explicit.
Scaled-mask clipping belongs to CPU control, not generated-output object clipping.
POST copies source outside edit regions, so background preservation does not prove foreground correction.
S3 native output is retained; all comparison metrics use even-frame selection at source time.
